cohort: A single patient presenting with a caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy.
finding: The abstract discusses the diagnosis, management, and outcome of a rare and peculiar case of caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy, emphasizing the difficulty of its diagnosis.
mod_finding: Increasing rates of caesarean deliveries are linked to the emergence of obstetric complications (placenta previa, placenta accreta, scar ectopic, scar rupture) and gynecological complications (AUB, pelvic pain, caesarean niche, secondary infertility).
